description: Use this to discover the structured filters accepted by tp_search_parks and tp_search_stays before filtering on amenities or curated highlights. Returns Total Parks features (e.g. pools, campfires, laundry) and curated highlights (e.g. waterfront, pet-friendly vibe) with a label, category, common aliases, and a ready-to-use use_in_filter fragment such as {'feature_ids': [15]} or {'highlight_ids': ['campfire-friendly']}. Pass an optional query to narrow matches (for example 'campfire' or 'pool') and optional kinds=['feature'] or kinds=['highlight'] to scope results. Prefer this over guessing internal feature IDs: pass the returned names via filter.feature_names or filter.highlight_names, or merge the use_in_filter fragment directly. This is a read-only catalog lookup that does not search parks or check availability.

kinds.description: Optional catalog kinds to return, such as 'feature' or 'highlight'. Accepts one kind or a list. Omit for all kinds.

limit.description: Maximum catalog entries to return. Default 50. Example: 20.

query.description: Optional text to filter the amenity/highlight catalog, such as 'campfire', 'pool', or 'pet'. Omit to list the full catalog page.

name: tp_search_filter_options

outputSchema.description: Discoverable catalog of structured search filters for the search tools.

items.description:
One discoverable search filter (a structured feature or curated highlight).

``use_in_filter`` mirrors the exact ``search.v1`` filter shape to merge into a
``tp_search_parks`` / ``tp_search_stays`` ``filter`` argument, so the caller
never has to memorise internal numeric feature IDs.

aliases.description: Extra traveller phrases that also resolve to this option.

id.description: Feature ID when kind='feature'; omitted for highlights.

kind.description: Whether this option is a structured feature or a curated highlight.

label.description: Traveller-facing name for this filter option.

slug.description: Highlight slug when kind='highlight'; omitted for features.

use_in_filter.description: Exact search.v1 filter fragment to pass, e.g. {'feature_ids': [15]} or {'highlight_ids': ['campfire-friendly']}.

title: Discover Total Parks search filters
